headline: Executive order changes how the U.S. handles international environmental agreements, with a stated goal of putting America first.
what_it_does: Based on its title, this order sets the U.S. approach to international environmental agreements. It tells the federal government to put U.S. interests first when joining, keeping, or taking part in these agreements. No summary was provided, so the specific actions and agreements involved are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies that negotiate or carry out international environmental agreements
who_it_affects.how: They would follow the order's direction on how the U.S. takes part in these agreements.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed January 20, 2025; specific deadlines are not given in the available information.
